description: Has this app ever been sent for Google Play review? ANSWERS WHAT get_pre_submit_status CANNOT: that tool reported review_eligible: true for an unreviewed draft app that could not publish by any route. An app that has never been reviewed cannot be rolled out to production at all. `ever_submitted_for_review` is the trustworthy field. The status codes are RAW AND UNMAPPED on purpose — a previous guess reported a live in-review submission as REJECTED — so do not read a verdict into them; Play Console's Publishing overview is the authority on the real state. If the submission history cannot be read, this returns submission_state_known: false rather than guessing 'never submitted'.

developer_id.description: Numeric Play Console developer id (from the Play Console URL).

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email that owns this Play Console developer account. Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user — do not guess.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

play_app_id.description: Numeric Play app id from the Play Console URL (.../app/<this>/...). NOT the package name.

name: get_app_submission_state
